convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for Parabolic SAR with time filtering (external .mqh or non-standard indicator params), time-based trading filter adds complexity, and partial position management with time-based exit gates

indicators.name: Parabolic SAR with Time Filter Plus

other_exits: Time-filtered exit: positions only managed within the allowed time window; SAR reversal signal closes opposite positions before opening new ones

custom_logic_notes: The 'Plus' variant adds a time window filter (TimeStart/TimeEnd inputs) that restricts both entry and exit to specified trading hours. Parabolic SAR direction flip triggers close of existing opposite position before new entry. The SAR indicator is accessed via iCustom with additional time parameters, making it a non-standard SAR implementation. Digit adjustment logic multiplies pip values by 10 for 5-digit/3-digit brokers.
external_dependencies: Custom SAR indicator with time filter (iCustom call to non-standard indicator)
python_conversion_notes: The custom Parabolic SAR with time filtering must be reimplemented in Python since iCustom references a non-standard MT5 indicator. The standard ta-library Parabolic SAR can be used as a base, but the time window filtering must be added on top. Digit adjustment logic (multiply by 10 for 5-digit brokers) must be replicated. The new bar guard uses IsNewBar pattern common in MT5 EAs - replicate using pandas bar-time comparison. Signal reversal close-then-open pattern must preserve execution order: close opposite first, verify flat, then open new position.
